subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-102.draft.md
summary: Independent attack found no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. ADV-D101-T3-01 is landed, the timed-launch hash/stat ordering is coherent, process architecture is bound to the target thin executable without sysctl.proc_cputype, the D-006 numerals and regression gates remain operative, status and implementation boundaries remain intact, and all frozen/cited identities match.

attack_results.evidence: The disposition at line 27 now says inode-only stat after purge immediately before cold and before an unpurged doctor, with no stat or hash inside the cold/warm pair. The first-release sequence at lines 96-106 and later-release sequence at lines 114-124 implement exactly that ordering. A diff against the frozen D-101 turn-3 subject confirms the numbered sequences are unchanged.

attack_results.attack: Still hashes P between purge and cold
attack_results.evidence: Lines 80-89, 96-103, and 114-119 require the full-file hash before purge and after the completed cold/warm pair; only inode stat occurs between purge and cold. The additional macOS hashes at lines 237-247 and 258-259 belong to the dedicated, discarded preflight launch, not a timed sequence.

attack_results.attack: Still treats sysctl.proc_cputype as process architecture
attack_results.evidence: Lines 233-235 expressly reject sysctl.proc_cputype. Lines 266-289 derive the macOS ISA from host architecture, the digest-bound thin executable, an exact spawn architecture preference, and target PID T's P_TRANSLATED bit.

attack_results.attack: Process architecture still observes the inspector or a fat slice
attack_results.evidence: Lines 145-152 and 166-173 reject fat/universal inputs. Linux reads target T's post-exec /proc/T/exe and target auxv/AT_PLATFORM at lines 191-225 and explicitly forbids /proc/self/exe. macOS reads target T's path, start identity, and P_TRANSLATED at lines 249-296; the preflight child is killed and excluded from timing.

attack_results.attack: Weekly image roll disables the 10% rule
attack_results.evidence: Lines 127-143 require current-VM Prev/Cand comparisons and state explicitly that weekly image rolls do not suppress the rule; weekly images may mix only as paired strata.

attack_results.attack: Warm p50 is a failure gate
attack_results.evidence: Lines 127-130 limit operative G03 quantities to cold p50/p95/p99 and warm p95/p99, and say warm p50 may be telemetry but must not fail qualification.

Lines 31-36 expressly preserve the numerals. The operative G03 quantities at lines 127-137 and G04 bounds at lines 65-73 match COORD D-006 lines 751-760 and its second-qualified-release 10% rule at lines 774-786. The scoped change is to the G03/G04 runner class, not threshold numerals.

The draft repeatedly negates QUALIFIED/DEMONSTRATED status (lines 11-13, 314-318, and exact file-08 replacement text) and line 360-362 forbids marking any DR row SATISFIED. Condition 4 MET is explicitly distinguished from QUALIFIED.

Lines 10 and 360-362 deny implementation authorization; lines 394-397 keep condition 5 NOT MET and last. The only specified file-08 replacements are the two reserved identifiers, the 16-of-18 fragment, the condition-4 snapshot cell, and its one-sentence clause.

Lines 3-7 identify D-102 as a new D-000 cycle at turn 1 of 3. COORD D-101 is CONTESTED and explicitly permits a later new cycle rather than a turn 4; this draft uses a new decision ID and does not amend the D-101 subjects.

Measured values match lines 412-418: COORD 151e8896c8785fee56c5c8856112b793df3ab930babae1b107ced9958ce1c50c; docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md 45dc4611717276c1f1c275982aa7ce787b2fa0b8fffbe1d315e8cb83ddff2206; freeze e809d4395f394a507c36c23c069d566c838b2283c931b6d2d13797be53406dbd; D-101 turn-3 subject ba5f8fc8ae336de0073642fd6e3ac2bc549988256b20068e2864df3ff1e66eae; Claude 2 turn-3 review 8e3828071c789ec2f05903ee1ed44af376b88751957f6ebf8e90bfa10d8c6921; Codex turn-3 review b0819a1dc14522c37d0caef61bdfec9c19778af622e44f9ac6b21e1931da6209. The predecessor commit c159c224c8766715b21a1522755aeb235c8335df exists and is current HEAD. Review files were hash-measured only, not opened.
The subject matched the dispatch digest at both measurements. The prompt measured 828d1494fbbcbe9e8e20254166e8fc90c38071e9e14884033d4333f0822ade37 at both start and end.

The three D-101 subjects measure 54333f8ec16398e0cd3d3bec15afb0b42c4e4a9740bfe7755e3326d083cd7864, 795c34e13e474b5007b33693d8399abb58df3910a79933ab6d927af2d922729b, and ba5f8fc8ae336de0073642fd6e3ac2bc549988256b20068e2864df3ff1e66eae.
